title: M-key mute chain broken: Key_Press .M is never mapped to the Toggle_Mute intent — mute, effect_mute, on_mute and the README claim are all dead code
evidence: app/input/poll.odin:60: `if rl.IsKeyPressed(.M) { append(&inp.events, Device_Event(Key_Press{key = .M})) }` — but input.odin:118 routes ALL Key_Press through `mouse_map(inp, events, &inp.intents)`, whose switches have no .M case. mouse.odin:79-90 (phase-1 collector): `#partial switch e.key {` / `case .P, .Space:` ... `case .D:` ... `case .T:` ... `case .Esc:` / `case: // R/Enter map via the Game_Over early return; phase-2 keys below`. mouse.odin:116-123 (phase-1 emitter): `case .P, .Space:` `append(out, Intent(Toggle_Pause{}))` / `case .D:` `append(out, Intent(Toggle_Overlay{}))` / `case .T:` `append(out, Intent(Toggle_Assist{}))` / `case .Esc:`. mouse.odin:316-343 (phase-2): `case .X, .Delete:` ... `case .U:` ... `case .One, .Two:` ... `case .E:` ... `case .S:` ... `case .B:` / `case: // phase-1 keys already handled`. exec.odin:44-46: `case Toggle_Mute:` / `// 7.2: the audio mute toggle — app effect (cosmetic; captions stay on).` / `if inp.on_mute != nil { inp.on_mute(inp.user, inp) }` — unreachable. Repo-wide grep for Toggle_Mute: declared (types.odin:147, union member types.odin:277), consumed (exec.odin:44) — produced NOWHERE. README.md diff hunk claims: "`M` mutes/unmutes audio (7.2; captions stay on while muted — every audio alert is also captioned on screen)."
detail: The diff wired poll, Key enum, Intent union, on_mute, apply_intent case and effect — but skipped mouse_map, where 5.4 translates every key to an intent. The advertised mute control does nothing; acceptance criterion 'M mutes' fails, silently.
recommended_fix: Add `case .M:` to mouse_map's phase-1 collector and emitter emitting `Intent(Toggle_Mute{})`, exactly mirroring the .T/.D pattern; widen the fixed `keys: [4]Key` buffer to [5].

title: Pending staging collapses multiple same-frame alerts into N plays of the last-drawn variant — earlier drawn variants never sound
evidence: audio.odin:79-84: `Pending :: struct {` / `crisis_plays:   u8,` / `crisis_variant: i32,` / `arrival_plays:  u8,` / `arrival_variant: i32,` / `}`. Consumer, audio.odin:166-167: `a.pending.crisis_plays += 1` / `a.pending.crisis_variant = variant`. Flush, audio.odin:192-197: `for _ in 0..<a.pending.crisis_plays {` / `rl.PlaySound(a.crisis[a.pending.crisis_variant])` / `}` / `for _ in 0..<a.pending.arrival_plays {` / `rl.PlaySound(a.arrival[a.pending.arrival_variant])`.
detail: Two same-kind alerts in one frame (catch-up arrivals passing the tick throttle, dual crises) stage two plays of only the last variant; the first drawn variant consumes a cosmetic draw but never plays. Fidelity only — determinism unaffected.
recommended_fix: Drop the play counters and flush each kind once, or stage a small fixed variant array per kind so every drawn variant plays.
